name: New 52-Week High: Forward 1-Month Returns
description: Detects when each equity makes a new 52-week high (close exceeds prior 252-day rolling max) and measures the subsequent 21-trading-day forward return. Compares post-new-high returns against unconditional (all-days) forward returns to assess whether momentum persists after breakouts. Outputs: histogram of post-new-high forward return distribution, comparison bars (median new-high vs all-days returns), and event markers for each new-high occurrence.
source:
# New 52-Week High: Forward 1-Month Return Analysis
# Detects new 52-week highs and measures subsequent 21-day returns
# Compares post-breakout returns vs unconditional baseline

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# --- 52-Week High Detection ---
# Rolling 252-day max, lagged 1 bar to exclude today's close
rolling_high_252 = max(period=252)(close)
prior_high = rolling_high_252 >> 1
is_new_high = close > prior_high

# --- Forward Returns (21 trading days ≈ 1 month) ---
fwd_21d = forward_returns(period=21)(close)

# --- Filtered Series ---
# Post-new-high forward returns (sparse — only on new-high days)
nh_fwd_21d = where(is_new_high, fwd_21d)

# Unconditional forward returns (all days, for baseline)
all_fwd_21d = fwd_21d

# --- Comparison Metrics ---
# Median forward return after new highs vs all days
# Using xy_bars series mode with Median aggregation
nh_median = nh_fwd_21d
all_median = all_fwd_21d

# Hit rate: % of new-high events with positive forward return
nh_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(nh_fwd_21d) and nh_fwd_21d > 0) else 0.0
nh_hit_filtered = where(is_new_high, nh_hit)

# --- Output 1: Histogram of Post-New-High Forward Returns ---
histogram(
    title='Do New Highs Lead to More Gains Over the Next Month?',
    category='New 52-Week High Analysis',
    bins=30,
    show_analytics=True,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7,
    x_axis_label='21-Day Forward Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(nh_fwd_21d)

# --- Output 2: Comparison Bars — New-High vs All Days ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Median 21-Day Return: New Highs vs All Days',
    category='New 52-Week High Analysis',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='After New High', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='All Days', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(nh_median, all_median))

# --- Output 3: Event Markers — Each New 52-Week High ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='New 52-Week High',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='21d Fwd Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Prior 252d High', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(close, fwd_21d, prior_high, is_new_high)
